mont_engineer.text: AIR Montserrat was George Martin's studio. Recorded here: Dire Straits' Brothers in Arms, The Police's Synchronicity, Elton John, Paul McCartney. A beach, a pool, a mixing desk.
Hurricane Hugo wrecked it in 1989 and the studio never reopened. This little annexe keeps the memory going.

mont_dj.text: I came for the music history. I stayed for the sunset. I'm told it goes on a bit.
They say the whole island turned out when the big names came. Everyone claims to have carried an amp.
